options.counterfactual: The quasitrace axioms alone force the quasitrace values of the terms of every positive series with bounded partial sums to tend to zero.
options.approach: Seek a quantitative estimate for positive elements whose sum is at most 1 that bounds how many can have quasitrace at least a fixed positive number. Such an estimate would rule out the required sequence without using the absence of a least upper bound.

options.counterfactual: The quasitrace axioms alone force the quasitrace values of the terms of every positive series with bounded partial sums to tend to zero.
options.approach: Reduce the positive increments to spectral projections and investigate whether the matrix extension of the quasitrace excludes infinitely many projections of uniformly positive quasitrace with bounded partial sums.
